title: WPMS/596/2005 of Sunil Kumar Vs Up Sanchalak Chabandi and Anr

paras.text:
WPMS No. 596 of 2005
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Sanjay Kumar, Advocate on behalf
of Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. J.S. Bisht, Brief Holder for the State
of Uttarakhand.
The petitioner in the writ petition has
challenged the concurrent order passed under
Section 21 of the Consolidation of Holdings Act.
On a number of occasions, the case has been
adjourned on the request of the learned counsel
for the petitioner. When the writ petition was
taken on 18th October, 2016, the petitioner was
granted time to take steps for serving respondent
No. 2. Petitioner has taken steps for serving
respondent on 22nd October, 2016. The notice,
thus, issued to respondent No. 2, as per the
office report dated 10th November, 2016, it
reveals that the notice has been received back
with the remark that respondent No. 2 has died.
The petitioner was further directed to file "dasti"
affidavit which has not been submitted as yet.
Thereafter, the case was listed on 11th
November, 2016 and on 19th July, 2017, Court
granted time to the petitioner to file substitution
application. As per the office report dated 16th
August, 2017, despite the time granted to the
petitioner, no substitution application has been
filed.
Since, there happens to be the only sole
private contesting respondent, who is reported to
be dead and no steps have been taken despite the
opportunity being granted, the writ petition is
dismissed as abated.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 17.08.2017
Shiv
